deficiencies.description: The lecturer refers to a specific specimen or case ('this meningioma obviously is occurring within the skull'), whereas the rewrite generalizes this into a universal statement ('A meningioma occurs within the skull... so it puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures'), stating as a general fact that meningiomas occur in the skull and exert enormous pressure on the brain.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this meningioma obviously is occurring within the skull.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A meningioma occurs within the skull, which is a confined space, so it puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures

considerations.sourcePassage: Obviously, when there is a suspicion of cancer or of a tumor, everybody gets very nervous about what that diagnosis is going to look like.
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders this as 'When cancer or a tumour is suspected, there is considerable anxiety about the diagnosis', which accurately conveys the meaning while removing conversational filler.

considerations.sourcePassage: smooth muscle fibroid that I showed you
considerations.reason: Rendered as 'smooth muscle fibroid, as shown earlier' with an added [FIGURE] mark, which is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: Okay, but that's not to say that a benign tumor can't be dangerous, because you can get benign tumors that cause death by growing and constricting on the processes of normal tissues that are adjacent to them.
considerations.reason: Dropping the conversational filler 'Okay' and rendering the spoken phrasing into standard textbook English preserves the exact meaning and causal link.

considerations.sourcePassage: This would put an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures and would cause and has caused Has caused death in this case.
considerations.reason: The false start and repetition ('would cause and has caused Has caused') were cleaned up into 'and in this case it caused death', which is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: Also, pituitary adenomas release a lot of hormones and can cause death in that way.
considerations.reason: Replacing 'a lot of hormones' with 'large amounts of hormones' uses different words with the exact same meaning.
Spelling 'tumour' in place of 'tumor' is an allowed British English spelling change.
